svg.title: Equivalent scaling changes the quantizer’s error
svg.desc: For W [0.13, 2] and x [10, 1], the dot product is 3.3. Scale channel 0 by four: W prime [0.52, 2], x prime [2.5, 1], same float dot 3.3. Fixed-step 0.25 quantization gives unscaled output 4.5 versus scaled output 3.25. Error changes from 1.2 to −0.05.

g.text: S = diag(4, 1): W′ = W S; x′ = S⁻¹ x
Fixed step 0.25, wide enough code range for this example:
Errors: +1.20 versus −0.05. The scale was chosen, not trained.
